idea-plugin.name: digoso.JbWindowManager
idea-plugin.description:
Save the arrangement of your tool windows as named profiles and switch between them with one click.

The built-in Window | Layouts cannot manage profiles. This plugin adds a Window | Profiles submenu to do exactly that.

Features

  • Save as… stores the current tool window arrangement under a name.
  • Click a profile in the menu to apply it.
  • Manage… renames or deletes profiles.

What a profile stores

For each tool window: the side (left, right, bottom, top), the split position (for example left/top versus left/bottom), open or closed, the view mode (docked, unpinned, undocked, floating, window), size and order, and the window position of floating and windowed tool windows.

A profile also stores the state of the main window (fullscreen, maximized, or its position and size). Positions are stored relative to the screen, so a profile still fits when you switch to another screen or resolution.

Not stored: editor splits and open files.

Good to know

  • Profiles are global and shared by all projects. They are kept in a JSON file in the IDE configuration folder.
  • Tool windows that do not exist in the current project are skipped when a profile is applied.
  • Built and verified for Rider 2026.3. Only the IntelliJ Platform is used, so other IntelliJ-based IDEs of the same version should work, but they have not been tested.

Source code and issue tracker: GitHub. Licensed under the MIT License.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.2.0: profiles also store the main window (fullscreen, maximized, position and size); positions are relative to the screen; the plugin no longer uses any internal IntelliJ Platform API. Profiles saved with 0.1.0 still work.
  • 0.1.0: initial release: save, apply, rename and delete tool window profiles via Window | Profiles.
